ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: As shown in the figure $\langle$img="q_11187_001.png"$\rangle$, it is the protein transport system in mitochondria. Similar to the situation in chloroplasts, proteins localized in the mitochondrial matrix also require the assistance of specific molecular chaperones in order to be transported through the inner membrane and outer membrane of mitochondria. During the transport process, it needs to pass through $\underline{\quad\quad\quad\quad\quad\quad}$, and subsequently is assisted by molecular chaperones in the matrix to fold into a functional conformation.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: What is shown in the figure is the mitochondrial protein transport system; structures such as the mitochondrial outer membrane, intermembrane space, inner membrane, and mitochondrial matrix can be seen; near the outer membrane and inner membrane are labeled TOM complex and TIM complex, and inside the mitochondrial matrix is also labeled matrix molecular chaperone, while outside the mitochondrion is labeled cytosolic molecular chaperone. Then reason: The question stem says that proteins localized in the mitochondrial matrix need to be transported through the mitochondrial outer membrane and inner membrane, and then are assisted in folding by molecular chaperones in the matrix. In the figure, when proteins cross the outer membrane and inner membrane, what they pass through are the TOM complex and TIM complex; this type of structure is essentially a transmembrane protein transport complex. Therefore the blank should be filled with "transmembrane protein complex".

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it shows a mitochondrion with outer membrane, intermembrane space, inner membrane, and matrix; the import path across the membranes is labeled with TOM复合体 and TIM复合体, with matrix molecular chaperones inside. Then read the question text: proteins destined for the mitochondrial matrix need chaperone assistance to cross both mitochondrial membranes, and the blank asks what they must pass through before matrix chaperones fold them. Connect the visual labels TOM/TIM to the concept of membrane-spanning translocase machinery, and fill the blank as “跨膜蛋白质复合体 / transmembrane protein complexes.”
